title: Cylinder
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and the translation vector also set to zero. Proceed to draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In this sketch, draw the first line from the origin at (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0), then draw the second line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0375). Continue by drawing the third line from (0.75, 0.0375) to (0.0, 0.0375), and finally, draw the fourth line from (0.0, 0.0375) back to the origin at (0.0, 0.0). After completing the sketch, apply a scaling factor of 0.75 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Transform the two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and translating it by the vector set to zero. Next, extrude the two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.0375 units, ensuring that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. This operation will result in a new solid body. The final part, named the cylinder, has a rectangular cross-section with rounded edges, a length of 0.75 units, a width of 0.0375 units, and a height of 0.0375 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0.0375).lineTo(0, 0.0375).close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.0375)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation (if needed)
# In this case, the coordinate system is the default (0, 0, 0) with no rotation, so no transformation is needed.

# Final model
r = cylinder

# Display the model

import cadquery as cq

# Square bar: length along X, square cross-section in Y/Z with rounded corners
r = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.005)
    .threePointArc((0.0015, 0.0015), (0.005, 0.0))
    .lineTo(0.0325, 0.0)
    .threePointArc((0.036, 0.0015), (0.0375, 0.005))
    .lineTo(0.0375, 0.0325)
    .threePointArc((0.036, 0.036), (0.0325, 0.0375))
    .lineTo(0.005, 0.0375)
    .threePointArc((0.0015, 0.036), (0.0, 0.0325))
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.005)
    .close()
    .extrude(0.75)
)
